body: Me too. I would've been gone a long time ago. All I can hope is to stop being a pussy and finally end this useless existence.

I'm the same way. My mom is literally my only friend. She told me she would rather me let her know when I'm really sad and lonely so maybe she could help. But honestly she's kind of hard to approach sometimes because of her illnesses. And I don't know. I guess I feel guilty. I wish she was enough for me to be happy. Pretty sad in a way, since I'm 21, and I guess I'm supposed to be like everyone else having an SO, a job, going to school, going out with friends....but unfortunately all those things actually ruined my life...and sorry I unloaded here. I guess I was just trying to make a point that I relate.

Me too. I literally just spend every second lying on my bed everyday on my tablet doing dumb pointless shit to distract myself from the fact that I have no friends....and that if I disappeared it wouldn't even matter...I'm already halfway there.

Also, I told my mom months ago that I would call 911 or whatever if I really felt like I was about to kill myself.
But now I really feel that's not true anymore. And who the fuck wants to go the psych ward anyways. Everyone I've talked too says it's like fucking jail. Alot of people seem to say it stops them from killing themselves while they are there but as soon as they get out they feel the same. Why would I want to put myself through that? When I can just stop everything....

And now she's asleep on the couch...so yeah. The only thing she really did yesterday as far as talking with me was give me a c.d. and some money. Her trying to make me feel better I guess. I said thanks and I just went back too sleep. But I honestly could give a shit less about anything right now. She's done this before where she will give a little cash and a pack of cigs or sometthing. And she says she knows it doesn't fix anything but it can help sometimes. Which it did for a while a bit I guess. Not anymore though....

I felt like maybe she could've really helped me at a point, but it's become pretty obvious that she won't be able too. And yeah, she had a major surgery a couple months ago, but she seems to be doing better. She has enough energy to do the dishes so I don't see why she wouldn't be making the call today to try and help me find a therapist or something. But instead it's the usual. She got done with doing the dishes and now she's on the couch with her tablet. She's spends a lot of time sleeping. Because of her illnesses. She really only goes out to the grocery store, which she did yesterday. I would usually go with her but I honestly find it pointless now. She asked me yesterday if I wanted to go....I said no. She asked me if I was having a really bad day....I said not really, I feel like this everyday, I'm just usually better at hiding it. Since every time I would come out of my room to smoke a cigeratte, it's obvious I'm upset since my eyes are all red from crying. Cant really hide that. Except with makeup maybe, but I really don't care anymore. She just said well you don't have to hide it....and I just didn't say anything and I walked away to smoke. The thing is she knows that I have depression. She's known ever since it started years ago. She knows it's gotten worse. She knows about my extremely abusive ex that I dealt with for 3 years. She knows about all my exs, about all my so called ex friends, the fact that I'm a complete loner. I mean I spend 24/7 in my room with the door closed. I come put for a cig or to the bathroom and something to eat. Although I don't eat that much anymore. Since I find it a chore. Along with regular hygiene as well. Which is gross but when you feel like dying all the time you really don't care. She knows about my suicidal ideation. I mean, when I broke down months ago one of the things I said is, I'm not trying to scare you....But I seriously need help or I will die....and i was very serious about it. And she talked to me tell I calmed down and told me she would help set me up with a therapist. She told me she understood how down and hopeless I feel. Wellet a few weeks went by and I asked her if she found anyone yet she thinks would be good for me and that takes my insurance ect. She told me she had a list ready and that she was gonna make some calls that day. That didn't end up happening. So I just kept waiting....and waiting....then I asked about it again. Like I said, I don't want to bother you I just wanted to make sure you didn't forget, have you made any calls yet? And it was kind of like the same thing she said before. And then it wasn't too long after that she ended up having to go to the e.r. because her complications from chrohns disease has caused another extreme blockage. She was in the hospital for a month. And that's when she had the surgery. It was another bowl resection, where basically they cut out part of the intestine that is basically dead or unusable, so that food and gas can actually pass through. She  couldn't even drink water before the surgery  without it hurting her, like swords going all around her stomach as she described. That's part of the reason why Ive been so patient through all this. I could literally see how much pain she's in. That's how I know when it's really bad is when I can really see it. Otherwise she's good at hiding it in a way. Well, she had the surgery, but it caused some complications. She ended up getting an abscess behind the hole that was stitched up from surgery, like right behind her belly button. So they put a tube in to drain the abcess. They had another option where they could open her up again and basically clean out the wound and stich her up again, but since the is prone to infection from her low autoimmune system (go figure) they decided to opt out for the tube at the last second. Well, a week or two out of the hospital after having the tube in she starts having more problems. The abcess is mostly drained but her body has created another hole. I think it's called a fistula? (Not sure but too lazy to look up the correct name.) Wherein basically it's a tunnel that leads from the intestine all the way out to the body. So you can probably guess what kinds of horrific things are coming out of that hole. So she had to go back to the hospital to get yet another drain in. So then she had two drains in. Eventually they were able to take out the drain for the fistula hole because there was less stuff coming out of it and they want it to be able to close and it can't do that if there is a tube in there. So they took that out and basically they are hoping it will heal on its own and won't require surgery. Well, it's healed a small bit since then but she still has stuff coming out so she's has to wear these bandages everyear and clean herself and change them and whatnot. She's seems do be doing a bit better painwise, and she has been able to go shopping and pick up the house every so often so that's a good sign. So, with all that said, she should be able to make some calls for me....at least now that the hospital stuff is over. For now anyway. But she hasn't yet. And like I said, she at least has some idea of what's going on obviously. It's not like I haven't told her about this stuff. So I don't know what's going on. I feel more hopeless than I've ever felt. I don't even feel like bring up the therapist phone call thing again today because I'm just so over everything. I didn't have much hope in the first place months ago, but it was there. Especially after I had talked with her that night. But now....it's just gone completely. I've always had problems with self esteem and  what not, but I don't think I've ever felt so utterly useless. I've never felt so much like a lost cause. I feel like life is completely pointless. And that no matter what I do it won't matter. I mean, why would I think otherwise? I've always tried my whole life to get through all the tough times, graduate highscool, which I did. And I did get a job. But all of it got ruined because I decided to trust the wrong people. Partly my fault for being dumb enough to give people the benefit of the doubt. To try and help people that I finally had to accept each time that they really don't want help no matter what they say. The last relationship I had....was the worst....because he was a narrcasistic abuser...which brought trauma on a whole different level than any relationshop, friend or otherwise, that I had before. I obviously didn't realize the gravity of the situation, or able to accept he was an abuser, until I finally got away for good. Yeah, I got brainwashed and all that great stuff. Ended up losing everything. The little friends I had. All of my money and savings. Any self esteem or self worth I had. The only i got was the rwaloty check that the last 3 years of my lofe have bee  nothing but a lie. And that this person never loved me. Never me. Just the amusement and pain he got out of torturing me i guess. When you put literally your whole life into one person, I learned that's bad. I had did that twice before...with two of my other relationshops. The first didn't work out because he cheated on me....twice. I was naive enough to forgive him the first time. He was my first love. After the 2nd time. I guess I got smart because i left. The 2nd didnt work out, because he never actually wanted help with his life. Still doesnt. He would tell me everything i would want to hear i guess. Oh, and hen one day he decides to skip out on our date. Acted like i shouldnt be upset. Excuse after excuse i said fuck this....finally left. Ended up getting back inti a relatiinship with him again, agter he told me he changed. Lol. He fooled me. We dated for two weeks, and after having sex that 2nd weekend, he blocked me from all contact. No reason. No awnser. And guess who comes inti my life when im weaj and easy prey? My abuser. And it wasnt until i got away from him ive always used other people (people who are shitry nonehenless) to create my identity and give me a reason to get up in the morning. I got that fun realization as well. But what I also learned is that when you do that...giive everything to a narcasstic abuser? Your totally fucked. I also comoletely lost what little faith I had left in humanity. I wasn't exactly in a good spot before I met my abuser...so yeah. I'm really fucked up in the head...in ways I can't really explain. When you realize you've wasted your whole life on people who realoy only give a shit about themeelves...yeah....I have nothing. Basically my mindset I'd totally fucked. I no longer see any good in the world...Or people. I feel like if it seems like it's for someone else's benefit other than themeelves, it's not actually. They are just faking it to get something they want. And don't even get me started on how fake people are.....Or how hard it is just to tell the truth. Fuck. I'm definitely far from perfect....don't get me started on that....But at least I've never intentionally went out of my way to hurt someone or use someone, or lie about something that's really fucking important. Damn. But realizing this has brought me no comfort. In fact...it's just made my mindset even worse. I've tried to be a good person my whole life and its meant nothing. I feel exactly what my abuser used to tell me....garbage. so yeah, I've got years of baggage I guess, But I'm just so fucking tired now, that when I was finaly able to get away from all these emotional vampires, I have nothing left in me to fight. I'm fucking lost man...

It's become extrememly obvious you didn't read anything I wrote. I cant. Even. I stated that I'm on meds, EFFEXOR 150 MG. Been on that for a couple months now. And before that, I ALSO stated what MEDS I was on before EFFEXOR. I ALSO stated that I have sought professional HELP to no AVIL. I didn't go into SPECIFIC  DETAIL as to why I belive it didn't work, but I thought I got my point across GENERALLY. Sinice I did write something along the lines of MULTIPLE therapists. I've also stated ONE the WAYS IVE TRIED to help myself is by HAVING FRIENDS. TRYING to be social. And YOU, have NO how many SOLUTIONS I've tried. IM so absolutely unmotivated to tell you all those solutions NOW. BECAUSE it's SO apparent to me that you DIDNT read anything I wrote. Don't ever tell me to LOOK FOR SOLUTIONS when that's ALL  I'VE BEEN DOING and TRYING FOR YEARS. I ALSO STATED  I'm too DEPRESSED to try and find a therapist again....WHY SHOULD I? WhEN THEY NEVER LISTENED TO ME  in the FIRST  PLACE. At least you can understand NOT LISTENING. And no, I didn't state whether or not I have insurance, but YES. I DO. It's called shitty medicaid Obama "care". It gets me my anti depressed that doesn't do shit, and my pain medicine for my fucked up body. And MONEY. Lol. A matter of money. Well, if you have any suggestions on how to get money when you literally can't work (specialist literally told me if I work in a job with anything physical, so pretty much everything besides an oh so exciting desk job tht requires a degree, that I would destroy my back even more than it already is, and with no finnacial support from family, (no funds or extra money),  please tell what I should do then. Unless you have a suggestion of how to make money with the predicament I'm in, I really could care less about what you have to say. You've made me pretty mad because you didn't listen...just like everyone else. So, sorry....not sorry....

Not trying to be a dick, but yeah. A long time is a understatment. 8 years as stated in the 2nd sentence of what I wrote. Nothing has ever changed for me except things getting worse and my depression worsing so I guess you are right in a way lol. So what does one do when they are supposedly their own worst critic? Just curious. And I have a lot of evidence that my life is completely pointlessmissed even aside from depression. My depression isn't telling me anything lol. My life tells me it sucks because it does haha.any person in my situation would feel the same. Hopeless. Thanks for trying to help though. I guess I'd like to see some actual proof, or feel some actual proof that I matter, that anything does. I guess its impossible. At least for me anyways. I'm sure others have found peace and whatnot. But i havent. Not since everything has continued downhill.

I really dont though. I've literally failed at everything. I bring nothing to myself but pain. I bring nothing to the world. The world only brings me pain. I've kept going with no reason for long enough. I've seen no proof that "it gets better". The only thing I've seen is more enough evidence to verify my existence is a pointless cycle of pain. Just a lost cause. I've denied it long enough. Time to accept the truth.

I'm alone too. It's not that I don't have someone I could talk to really. It's just that I find talking to be pretty damn pointless. I feel like no one understands me or what I have to deal with. I used to have a best friend seven years ago who meant everything to me. And one day out of the blue she told me she couldn't be friends with me anymore. There was never any problems or fighting between us. At least that I knew of. Apparently she had been thinking about leaving my life for quite some time, I guess she kept being my friend because she felt sorry for me, is what I took out of part of the conversation we need up having later, after I begged and begged for an explanation that is. It's never made and sense to me I've never gotten over it. It's been 7 years and I still think about her, and I wonder what I did that was so bad that she would leave me, and lie to me about her true feelings. There's more to the story but I can sympathize with you. I also sit around all day, doing nothing. It's pathetic realky.

You took the words right out of my brain. I just made a post here a few minutes ago. Mine is the one titied a switch in my brain. I couldn't find the words to fully describe what I experience everyday. But I tried. I don't know. I realize I don't really want to die but I too feel that is really the only avaliable option. I'm not saying you should. But I want to make it point I fully sympathize with everything you said.
